release_notes.body:
## 更新内容

- 新增 ZCode 接单：内置 ZCode Agent 适配器；ZCode 输出停在对象中间时，读取不再卡住。
- 规则可以写可选的会话标题 `title`，放在提示词第一行，按第一条消息给会话起名的客户端能分清每个事项。
- 暂停期间跳过的事件现在看得到、能补跑：`resume` 和 `status` 会列出暂停期间跳过的事件，新增 `agent-autoloop replay <规则> --since <时间>`（也有接口和 MCP 版本）。打印的补跑命令照抄就能用，Windows 上也一样。
- 交付：GitHub 的检查一直排队不动时，自动重新触发一次；仍不动就立刻退回并说明原因，不再白等两个多小时。
- 交付：修复复查会话的归属和交付终态。
- 协议文档补上 healthz 和 state 的两个字段。


## What's changed

- ZCode support: a built-in ZCode agent adapter; reading ZCode output that stops in the middle of an object no longer hangs.
- Rules can set an optional session `title`, put on the prompt's first line, so clients that name a session after its first message can tell runs apart.
- Events skipped while a rule was paused are now visible and can be replayed: `resume` and `status` list them, and there is a new `agent-autoloop replay <rule> --since <time>` (also over HTTP and MCP). The printed replay command works as copied, Windows included.
- Delivery: when GitHub leaves a check queued with no jobs, it is re-triggered once; if it still doesn't start, the PR is handed back at once with the reason instead of waiting over two hours.
- Delivery: fixed which session a follow-up review belongs to, and delivery end states.
- The protocol now documents two more fields of healthz and state.

- 应急交付遇到临时故障后，可以在原来的临时目录重试。
- 项目扩大深审范围时，交付插件会按实际要求的深度核对已有审查。需要更深的审查时会重新审查改动。

- 多个项目可以共用一份审查策略。交付插件记下每轮审查，续审时聚焦新提交。
- 交付插件按已检查的提交推进合并，核实 Ship 和线上版本，并可把进度和通知接到已有工具。
- 规则可以限制每个项目和执行者同时在手的任务数。
- 中台停机时，可以在接单电脑上用同一个插件直接处理一张已交接的 PR。

[配置手册](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/blob/v1.8.0/skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#交付流水线)

## 修复

- Windows 拒绝注册新的登录任务时，原任务和运行中的中台继续工作。注册成功后才换进程。（#208、#214）
- Windows 接单程序恢复用例先确认 Agent 实际启动，再制造故障。（#219）

从 `v1.7.1` 或更早的版本第一次升级，Windows 请重跑 [PowerShell 安装命令](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/blob/v1.7.2/INSTALL.md#安装)。安装器切到新版本后用新的进程更新登录任务，当次升级即采用修复后的顺序。

## 新增

- 飞书提问卡片支持直接填写并提交文字回答。（#228）
- `rules.json` 的 `defaultChannels` 可以指定没有单独通道设置的卡片和通知发到哪里。（#223）
- 交付项目可通过 `review.agents` 按写代码的 Agent 配置审查器或免审，关键路径仍按项目的深审规则处理。（#224）

---

## Fixes

- When Windows refuses to register an updated login task, the existing task and running hub stay available. The process is replaced after successful registration. (#208, #214)
- The Windows worker recovery test waits for the agent to actually start before introducing the fault. (#219)

For the first Windows upgrade from `v1.7.1` or earlier, rerun the [PowerShell installer](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/blob/v1.7.2/INSTALL.md#安装). It switches to the new version before invoking the service installer, so this upgrade already uses the corrected order.

## Added

- Feishu question cards can accept a free-text answer. (#228)
- `defaultChannels` in `rules.json` sets where cards and notices without an explicit channel list go. (#223)
- Delivery projects can choose a reviewer or an exemption per authoring agent with `review.agents`. Critical paths retain the project's deeper review policy. (#224)

[All changes](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/compare/v1.7.1...v1.7.2)

## 修复

- **macOS 服务起不来**：从图形界面应用里拉起的终端（umask 为 0）安装时，LaunchAgent 的 plist 会被写成所有人可写，launchd 拒绝加载，只报 `Bootstrap failed: 5`；之后怎么重装都卡在这里。现在每次安装都把它设成 644，重装一次就能修好已经坏掉的机器。（#210）
- **Codex 断线又恢复的一轮被当成没跑成**：Codex 中途报 `Reconnecting...`、随后自己换了传输方式跑完，原来会被判成失败、整轮重做。现在跑完了就算跑完。（#211）
- **收件箱模板漏信**：被 `skipSenders` 跳过的通知邮件不再占读取名额，列表会一页页往下翻；没读到时间窗尽头（包括收满上限而后面还有）时，快照、回执和清单都写明还有邮件没读，不再说成“没有需要看的邮件”。（#212、#216）

## 新增

- MCP 新增 `pause`、`resume`、`run` 三个工具，和命令行一样暂停、恢复、立即运行一条规则，要本人密钥。（#203）
- `agent-autoloop rules explain [文件]` 显示规则只发的通道，也能读一份草稿文件。（#204）
- README 写明 OpenClaw 的 `agent exec` 默认每次只跑 600 秒，长任务在命令里加 `--timeout`。（#215）


---

## Fixes

- **macOS service never starting**: installing from a shell with umask 0 (one a GUI app opened) left the LaunchAgent plist world-writable, which launchd refuses to load with only `Bootstrap failed: 5`, and reinstalling kept the bad mode. Every install now sets it to 644, so one reinstall repairs an affected machine. (#210)
- **A Codex run that reconnected was counted as failed**: when Codex reported `Reconnecting...` mid-run and then finished on another transport, the whole run was thrown away and redone. A finished run now counts as finished. (#211)
- **Inbox triage missing mail**: senders in `skipSenders` no longer use up the read limit; the listing is paged. When the window wasn't read to its end (including when the limit filled while more mail remained), the snapshot, receipt and checklist say mail was left unread instead of "nothing to read". (#212, #216)

## New

- MCP gains `pause`, `resume` and `run`, matching the CLI commands for pausing, resuming and running a rule now; they need the owner key. (#203)
- `agent-autoloop rules explain [file]` shows a rule's `channels` and can read a draft file. (#204)
- The README notes that OpenClaw's `agent exec` stops each run after 600 seconds by default; add `--timeout` for long work. (#215)
